runbook_fixes.now: open /community/connect-app?scheme=jetonomyapp&app_name=Jetonomy%20app with a valid app link as bob -> 'Connect Jetonomy app to your account?' and 'You are signed in as Bob Martinez (bob)' (login in parentheses, button 'Yes, connect the app').

GET /app/config logged out -> app_name, labels, features, accent_color, logo_url, terms_url, privacy_url, support_url, pro_active, flag_reasons, attachments and auth{connect_url,connect_schemes}; there is no base-URL key.
scheme must be 'jetonomyapp'; use any other scheme (for example scheme=jetonomy) for the refusal.
POST /auth/app-connect (a fresh bridge token each) 6 times -> 429 from the 6th (cap is 5 per hour per member).
the forward carries app_name, app_id, scheme and state only; use scheme=jetonomyapp
